heading: About Gunukula Kishore
introduction: Gunukula Kishore served as the District General Secretary of the Janasena Party in Nellore, Andhra Pradesh. A committed grassroots leader, he has worked consistently to strengthen the party's presence and voice the concerns of the people of Nellore district.
leadership: As a senior functionary of Janasena in Nellore district, Kishore plays an active role in organizational activities, public outreach and mobilizing party workers (Jana Sainiks) around the district.
publicService: He has been a vocal advocate on local governance issues, regularly engaging with the media and public on matters affecting Nellore district, from infrastructure to accountability in local administration.
